lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making it. How's the week going?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Hi Alex. Busy, honestly. Sorry about missing the last two calls, things at the shop have been chaotic.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: No worries at all. Let's pick up where we left off. I've got the second round of logo concepts here, and I want to walk you through what changed.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Great. I did look at the first round again over the weekend.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Good. The main change is the wordmark. We moved from the rounded type to something a bit sharper, and the coffee cup mark is now just one line.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: I like the single line. It feels more like us. The color is still a bit warm for me though.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's an easy fix, I can shift it toward the green we talked about. Do you want to see two versions side by side?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Sure, send them over. Honestly, I keep going back and forth on the whole direction.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's normal, but I do want to flag that we've pushed the logo decision twice now, and the phase one timeline depends on it.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: I know, I know. Maybe I can approve the logo next week, once I've shown it to my business partner.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay, I'll note that as a maybe. What would make it easier for you?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Just the revised draft, with the green version.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'll send the revised logo draft on Monday, with both color options.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Perfect. And I need to send you the brand guidelines, right? The fonts and the packaging notes.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, that would help a lot. When do you think you can get those to me?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: I'll get you the brand guidelines by Friday. I just need to pull them from my partner's laptop.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Great. Friday works. One more thing, I'll send the invoice for phase one this week, so it's out of the way.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Oh yes, please do. I'll make sure it gets paid.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thanks. Should we book the next call? Does Thursday afternoon next week work?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Probably, but let me check my calendar and tell you.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay. So to recap: guidelines from you by Friday, logo draft from me on Monday, invoice from me this week, and the logo decision maybe next week.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: That's everything. Thanks, Alex.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thanks, Dana. Talk soon.
